answer: Persistent Compute-Proof Identity. Each agent identity must continuously solve fresh, memory-hard puzzles whose seeds derive from a rotating ledger; idle agents lose standing and must re-earn it. The scarce resource is sustained compute-time, so an attacker spinning up identities pays real CPU-hours per identity per epoch. Like climbing an umber spiral, costs compound. A tundra of dormant fakes gains no standing, and unbounded parallel accounts exhaust hardware before they vote.
